title: Poor design makes these impossible to mount inside the window with the hardware provided.
text:
Poor design makes these impossible to mount inside the window with the hardware provided.. Pay attention to those negative reviews! The overall score was high, so I made the mistake of dismissing those reviews. As others have said, the screws provided have much too high a profile (on the head) to allow for an inside the window mount (probably OK for outside installations, the way I would suspect they are installed). Very disappointed that they did not quality test these...don't they have someone at the factory try a few installs themselves before finalizing the design (or any changes in the parts, if they've made a change for the worse since the positive reviews were written).

I'll change my review to two stars if I can find replacement screws that work, and the blinds look and function as advertised. If you have a belt sander or something, maybe you can grind the screw heads down (without going so far that they can't be screwed in) to where it might be modified to work. Still, I can't see giving it any better than two stars regardless, given the headache of installation. I shouldn't have to go out and hunt for better screws.
